target_customer: Small and medium businesses in India with hourly or daily staff, paying for a payroll and attendance app; secondary aim of a credit and skills profile for blue-collar workers
problem: Indian SMEs run attendance and payroll on paper or spreadsheets and punch-in systems; blue-collar workers have no formal credit profile.
business_model: Mobile SaaS subscription for payroll, attendance and expense management (pricing not verified)
product_category: SMB payroll, attendance and expense app

founders.name: Apoorva Sharma
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page. Background not found in an opened source.

founders.name: Poorva Dixit
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page. No background found.

competitors.name: PagarBook
competitors.what: Payroll and attendance app for Indian small businesses

competitors.name: OkCredit (OKStaff)
competitors.what: Ledger app with a staff management product

competitors.name: Khatabook (Pagar Khata)
competitors.what: Ledger app with a staff payroll and attendance app

technical_complexity.rationale: Mobile CRUD app with selfie and GPS attendance and payroll calculation; Indian statutory rules add some work but nothing research grade.

defensibility.rationale: Funded competitors sold the same attendance and payroll features; selfie attendance is easy to copy and no network or data lock-in is evidenced.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Khatabook and OkCredit shipped staff payroll products and PagarBook scaled with large funding; SalaryBook stayed small.

market_need_then: The YC description cites about 60 million Indian SMEs managing staff manually; the sector had several funded rivals by 2020, which shows demand.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, benefit led copy about replacing punch-in systems

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand found; name is easily confused with SalaryBox, a same batch company in the same market, and PagarBook.

outcome_analysis: SalaryBook is listed as active with a team of 7 and no disclosed funding beyond YC. Same batch rival SalaryBox raised $4M within months and incumbents PagarBook, Khatabook and OkCredit had funding and distribution, so SalaryBook appears to have stayed small. The failure factor reflects that inference and is not stated by any source.
notes: Funding of about $125K in Sept 2021 appears only on aggregators (thecompanycheck, extruct) and is unverified, so no round is recorded. Aggregators disagree on founders (Ankita Sharma appears on some, not on the YC page) and on founding year (2020 vs 2021). Legal entity name reported as Vyzy Private Limited by one aggregator. Website fetch returned only a title. Competitor source dates for OkCredit and Khatabook are not known.
